head.title: STACEY Mitte
head.subtitle: Most Central Coliving in Berlin
head.description: Fischerinsel 13-15, 10179 Berlin, directly in the mix. 5 minutes to the Berliner Dom, Gendarmenmarkt or Alexanderplatz. Suites measure up to 38 m² across shared apartments and private studios, and every shared apartment has just one other room.

neighborhood.title: The Neighborhood
neighborhood.subtitle: Mitte, Berlin
neighborhood.description: On the Fischerinsel, next to the Museumsinsel, a central, Berlin-style living experience between historic landmarks like Alexanderplatz and the Berliner Dom, while still only minutes away from the cool Kreuzberg area. The U-Bahn station Märkisches Museum is directly outside.

head.title: STACEY Moabit
head.subtitle: Green Coliving in Berlin Moabit
head.description: Stromstraße 48a, 10551 Berlin, in a modern house behind the courtyard in Moabit. Three suites share each apartment, most with access to a shared balcony to the garden or the courtyard, and the Ensuite suites come with a private bathroom. U Turmstraße is a few minutes' walk away.

neighborhood.title: The Neighborhood
neighborhood.subtitle: Moabit, Berlin
neighborhood.description: Moabit is a real Berlin neighbourhood on an island between the Spree and its canals, with cafés along Turmstraße and the Arminius market hall. The Kleiner Tiergarten park and U Turmstraße are a few minutes' walk away, and Berlin Hauptbahnhof is close by.

head.title: STACEY Downtown
head.subtitle: The Heart of Hamburg
head.description: Directly between the city center and the UNESCO World Heritage Speicherstadt. Suites of up to 18 m² with 5-meter-high ceilings, set in a historic building voted Hamburg's most beautiful facade.

neighborhood.title: The Neighborhood
neighborhood.subtitle: Altstadt, Hamburg
neighborhood.description: Sightseeing right on your doorstep. Restaurants, cafés and every major public transport line are just steps away, perfect for both leisure and business stays in Hamburg's liveable downtown.

head.title: STACEY Alster
head.subtitle: Coliving next door to Udo
head.description: Centrally located in Hamburg St. Georg. Our suites are spread over 4 floors, measuring up to 18 m², some with optional balcony. A converted former office building dedicated exclusively to short-term coliving, with a community kitchen on the top floor and laundry facilities in the basement.

neighborhood.title: The Neighborhood
neighborhood.subtitle: ASt. Georg, Hamburg
neighborhood.description: We sit on Gurlittstraße between the Alster lake and the lively Lange Reihe restaurant street, roughly ten minutes on foot from central Hamburg's attractions. St. Georg is colorful, diverse and one of the city's most characterful neighborhoods.

head.title: STACEY Mühlenkamp
head.subtitle: The Cradle of Coliving
head.description: Since 2019, STACEY welcomes tenants from all over the world at Hamburg's #1 address for coliving, directly next to the beautiful lake Alster. Our oldest and largest coliving property features private suites of up to 27 square meters within shared apartments, surrounded by restaurants, bars and cafés, and wrapped around a quiet inner courtyard.

neighborhood.title: The Neighborhood
neighborhood.subtitle: Winterhude, Hamburg
neighborhood.description: Winterhude offers a unique blend of serene central living and vibrant social opportunities. Our coliving is tucked away on a quiet street between the well-known Mühlenkamp and the green heart of Hamburg, the Alster. A bus station within 100 meters connects you to downtown in 10 minutes, and the Alster is just around the corner for running or paddleboarding.

head.title: STACEY Eppendorf
head.subtitle: Coliving for Locals
head.description: Centrally located in Hamburg Eppendorf, our coliving offers suites of up to 17 m², some with optional balconies. A maximum of 4 suites per apartment strikes the balance between privacy and community living.

neighborhood.title: The Neighborhood
neighborhood.subtitle: Eppendorf, Hamburg
neighborhood.description: Eppendorf is the neighborhood every local wants to live in, green parks, boutique shops and some of Hamburg's most acclaimed brunch spots. The U-Bahn connects you to Sternschanze and the city center within 10 minutes.

head.title: STACEY St. Pauli
head.subtitle: Central, Colorful, Diverse
head.description: Cozy shared living next to the Millerntor stadium. Our 7-bedroom duplex coliving apartment has everything you need within its doors, living room, common kitchen and the old-building charm that (let's be honest) is unmatched by new developments.

neighborhood.title: The Neighborhood
neighborhood.subtitle: St. Pauli, Hamburg
neighborhood.description: St. Pauli sits between Hamburg's nightlife area and Sternschanze, the best of both worlds. You can reach every major Hamburg hotspot within 15 minutes via public transport, and the Elbe river and city center are just around the corner.

head.title: STACEY Eimsbüttel
head.subtitle: Beautiful, Peaceful & Quiet
head.description: Our smallest coliving location is in Hamburg-Eimsbüttel, a neighborhood of locals. The shared apartment offers a kitchen and a small inner yard. You can choose between private suites of up to 17 m².

neighborhood.title: The Neighborhood
neighborhood.subtitle: Eimsbüttel, Hamburg
neighborhood.description: Eimsbüttel gives you an authentic Hamburg experience, a diverse community of families, students and long-time residents. Sternschanze and Osterstraße (the neighborhood's shopping and dining hub) are right next door, and downtown is about 20 minutes away.

head.title: STACEY Vallendar
head.subtitle: The Cradle of the Spirit
head.description: Centrally located in Vallendar, less than 4 minutes on foot from all WHU university buildings. The property features spacious terraces and modern community spaces designed for studying and socializing in equal measure.

neighborhood.title: The Neighborhood
neighborhood.subtitle: Vallendar, Vallendar
neighborhood.description: We're right on Löhrstraße, in the heart of Vallendar. You won't need a bike or a car: everything is within walking distance, with restaurants on Hellenstraße, the WHU campus next door, and Koblenz a few minutes away by train.
